name: V zone tumana
source:
The story takes place in one of the many alternative camps. The narrative is told alternately from the perspectives of the Pioneer and Semyon, the protagonists of the story. The focus of the story is all about the mysterious Pioneer's past. How many shifts has he survived, and what events influenced his personality so much that he has such a nasty temper and behavior? How did he discover the ability to travel to other camps, and why does he hide his past so carefully? Is there at least some sense to his actions, or is he really as unhinged as he seems?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=698140759]Steam[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在众多另类营地之一。故事从故事主角先锋和谢苗的角度交替讲述。故事的焦点都是关于神秘的先锋的过去。他经历了多少次轮班，又是什么事件对他的性格影响如此之大，以至于他的脾气和行为如此恶劣？他是如何发现前往其他营地的能力的，为什么他如此小心地隐藏自己的过去？他的行为是否至少有一定道理，或者他真的像他看上去的那样精神错乱吗？

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=698140759]Steam[/url]]
